raw_text: Synthetic satellite imagery purporting to show a new Chinese military base in Ladakh has been debunked by Indian defence officials and independent analysts. Comparison with authentic Sentinel-2 and Planet Labs imagery of the same coordinates revealed no such structures exist. The Indian Express can confirm that GAN artifact analysis detected repeating texture patterns and shadow angles inconsistent with the claimed time of acquisition.
clean_text: Synthetic satellite imagery of alleged Chinese base in Ladakh debunked. Authentic Sentinel-2 and Planet Labs imagery shows no structures. GAN artifact analysis confirmed fabrication.
